question: What is the primary function of monitoring devices within nursing informatics?

options.A: Capturing and converting physiological data into digital metrics
options.D: Replacing the need for physical assessments by nurses

explanation: Monitoring devices translate real-time physical phenomena into digital signals that feed into clinical systems for tracking and documentation. [learn more](GNS113_U4_T2#GNS113_U4_T2_h1)

question: Why is proper sensor placement critical when utilizing digital monitoring equipment?

options.A: It stops all automated alarms from sounding
options.B: Inaccurate initial data collection compromises downstream clinical decisions
options.C: Manufacturers legally require specific anatomical locations
options.D: It prevents the electronic health record from crashing

explanation: Because clinical systems rely on the data generated by sensors, flawed initial placement leads to bad data that can misinform care decisions. [learn more](GNS113_U4_T2#GNS113_U4_T2_h1)

question: What physical property does a pulse oximeter use to calculate oxygen saturation?

options.A: Thermal changes in peripheral capillary blood flow
options.B: Electrical resistance across the epidermal skin layers
options.C: Differential light absorption by oxygenated and deoxygenated hemoglobin
options.D: Direct measurement of dissolved oxygen gas in arterial blood

explanation: Pulse oximeters measure how red and infrared light are absorbed differently by blood depending on its oxygenation level. [learn more](GNS113_U4_T2#GNS113_U4_T2_h2)

question: Which clinical situation can cause a falsely normal pulse oximetry reading despite tissue hypoxia?

options.C: Heavy nail polish on the finger

explanation: Carbon monoxide binds strongly to hemoglobin and is read similarly to oxygen by standard oximeters, hiding true tissue hypoxia. [learn more](GNS113_U4_T2#GNS113_U4_T2_h2)

question: What is the primary purpose of skin preparation before applying ECG electrodes?

options.A: To sterilize the dermal tissue against infection
options.B: To prevent the adhesive from causing chemical burns
options.C: To reduce electrical impedance and minimize artifact
options.D: To enhance the absorption of topical conductive gels

explanation: Cleaning oils and dead skin from the application site ensures a clean electrical signal without interference or false alarms. [learn more](GNS113_U4_T2#GNS113_U4_T2_h3)

question: Why might a critical care unit prefer a five-lead cardiac monitoring system over a three-lead system?

options.A: It provides a broader multi-vector view that assists in localizing ischemia
options.B: It completely eliminates the possibility of false arrhythmia alarms
options.C: It transmits data via satellite instead of local hospital networks
options.D: It requires fewer disposable patches to be placed on the chest

explanation: Five-lead systems allow for enhanced vector monitoring, which helps clinicians pinpoint specific areas of myocardial ischemia or injury. [learn more](GNS113_U4_T2#GNS113_U4_T2_h3)

question: How do telemetry transmitters communicate patient heart rhythms to the central monitoring station?

options.D: Infrared light beams across the ceiling

explanation: Telemetry units use wireless signals to broadcast ECG data from mobile patients to a central nursing station. [learn more](GNS113_U4_T2#GNS113_U4_T2_h4)

question: A patient on telemetry preparation for a walk requests to go outside the designated monitoring range. What is the priority nursing action?

options.A: Increase the alarm volume on the central station to maximum
options.B: Disconnect the telemetry pack entirely since the patient feels fine today
options.C: Instruct the patient to turn off the device until they return to bed
options.D: Explain the necessity of staying within range and arrange supervised portable monitoring if needed

explanation: Patients must remain within the functional broadcast range of the telemetry system to ensure continuous oversight of their cardiac rhythm. [learn more](GNS113_U4_T2#GNS113_U4_T2_h4)

question: What phenomenon occurs when staff become desensitized due to an excessive volume of low-priority device alarms?
explanation: Constant exposure to frequent, often non-actionable alarms leads to delayed responses or desensitization among healthcare providers. [learn more](GNS113_U4_T2#GNS113_U4_T2_h5)

question: How do clinical decision support algorithms improve patient safety in acute care settings?

options.A: By replacing bedside nursing shift handovers entirely
options.B: By aggregating disparate monitoring streams to calculate early warning scores automatically
options.C: By diagnosing complex pathologies without requiring physician input
options.D: By automatically administering emergency medications when vitals drop

explanation: CDS systems process multiple data inputs simultaneously to spot subtle downward trends and alert staff before crises fully manifest. [learn more](GNS113_U4_T2#GNS113_U4_T2_h5)

question: Which of the following is NOT an ethical responsibility of the nurse regarding digital monitoring devices?

options.A: Upholding patient dignity during the use of surveillance tools
options.B: Educating patients on the clinical purpose of continuous tracking
options.C: Selling aggregated patient biometric data to third-party tech vendors
options.D: Protecting wireless data transmissions from unauthorized access

explanation: Selling patient data violates privacy regulations and ethical standards; nurses must protect, not commercialize, patient information. [learn more](GNS113_U4_T2#GNS113_U4_T2_h6)

question: Why is patient education regarding continuous monitoring devices an essential ethical practice?

options.A: It legally transfers all liability for equipment failure to the patient
options.B: It respects patient autonomy by explaining how personal data is collected and used
options.C: It ensures the hospital avoids paying device licensing fees
options.D: It prevents patients from ever requesting device removal

explanation: Transparent communication empowers patients to understand their care environment and preserves their right to be informed about monitoring. [learn more](GNS113_U4_T2#GNS113_U4_T2_h6)
